entries.purpose: Public allowlist gateway for /connect, profile delivery/import QR endpoints, token-scoped profile delivery/import paths, and public speed-token paths.
token_reads: Token value is parsed from URL path for /profile-delivery/<token>, /profile-import/<token>, /speed-test/<token>, and /api/public-speed-sample/<token>.
entries.onboarding_behavior: Forwards /connect and /api/connect/* requests to the admin upstream after public-path allowlisting.
entries.secret_redaction_behavior: Does not log requests through BaseHTTPRequestHandler.log_message override; strips Cookie and Authorization headers before proxying; does not read profile-delivery-tokens.json.
entries.verification_requirement: python3 -m py_compile only; do not run gateway service in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Runtime-critical public ingress surface. It does not create, rotate, persist, or print profile delivery tokens, but it exposes token-bearing paths and therefore must stay release-owned.
